Exercise 9.
a) About the 60% the time of the talk shows is in dialect or in a mixture; The news is mostly in fuṣḥā; i

Most of them in dialect. Defenders of fuṣḥā: is the language that unites all Arabs; the dialect in the media threatens the unity of the language and lowers the level of the new generations. Supporters of the dialect: it is the true language of the people; The programs are closer to the viewer and more spontaneous. For the linguist, reality is not "fuṣḥā on the one hand, and dialect on the other, but gradual levels including those who speak move according to topic and audience; switching to the dialect for an example or a joke is not a mistake. The study proposes to teach students to consciously switch from one level to another. Attribution verbs: ⁧كشفت، يرون، ترى، تضيف⁩ ; ḥāl: ⁧موضحة⁩ .
b) Second intervention: fuṣḥā (thank you and given: ... ⁧فوق الثلاثين في المئة⁩ Egyptian → (specific example)

and the voice of the people: ⁧يعني بصراحة كده⁩ … ⁧بقى بخمسين⁩ !»; signals: ⁧كده، اللي، بتنزل، ده، بقى⁩ ). Third intervention: fuṣḥā (concession and subject: ⁧صحيح، ولا أنكر ذلك⁩ ... → Egyptian (direct appeal: ⁧احنا محتاجين⁩ … ⁧مش نستورد كل حاجة⁩ »; signals: ⁧احنا، محتاجين، مش، حاجة⁩ ) → fuṣḥā (proposed: ⁧ولذلك أدعو إلى خطة وطنية⁩ …»). Last intervention: Egyptian (spoken to lighten a difficult question: "... ⁧الإجابة دي، كنت بقيت وزير⁩ !»; signals: ⁧دي، بقيت⁩ ) → fuṣḥā (serious prediction, in mode: ⁧أتوقع، إذا سارت الأمور كما ينبغي⁩ …»).

Exercise 10 · Example. a) Doctor, the government says that prices will stabilize by the end of the year. Do you agree with this assessment? / Guest: First of all, thank you for the invitation. In fact, the latest indicators do not justify this optimism: the inflation rate is still above 30%. In short, let's be clear: the lady who goes to the market every day knows these things better than any relationship. The kilo that cost twenty now costs fifty! / Leader: But the government has taken steps to support poor families... / Guest: It is true, and I do not deny it. But support alone is not enough if production does not grow. We have to work and produce, not care everything. That is why I call for a national plan to support local industry, in cooperation with the private sector. / Conductor: One last question, in short: when will the citizen feel an improvement? If I knew, I'd be a minister by now! I expect that if things go as they should, we will see a real improvement within two years. b) It's true, and I don't deny it. But support alone is not enough if production does not grow. We have to work and produce, not import everything. [back to fuṣḥā] For this reason I ask for a national plan to support local industry, in collaboration with the private sector. 11 · Examples. a)

Exercise 12. a) The data in fuṣḥā, the example in Egyptian. Code Switching ( ⁧التناوب اللغوي⁩ ). The fuṣḥā for data, definitions and conclusions; the dialect for examples, jokes and emotions. That does not pronounce the finals of words (fuṣḥā Talked). When reading a news report or giving a written speech; internal vowels must always be correct. b) Because the program is being watched in all Arab countries. When a guest gets angry: the dialect loosens tension. To bring back the debate on the subject or ask a specific question, why the fuṣḥā gives weight; and closing. They are frequent in Lebanon (economy, medicine) and even more so in the Maghreb. Changing the register into English, from formal to daily, and reporting the passage between brackets in a report. Because it says when the guest speaks in his official capacity and when as any person. c) Initiation fuṣḥā (basmala, greetings, factory and thousand jobs); central part in Egyptian (a personal memory: two years earlier the place was a desert, only sun and dust, and asked him who would come to work on it): beat and closeness to the public; closure in fuṣḥā (the fruit of the collaboration between the State and privates, thanks, full greeting).
